# HappyBein
# Framework: Astro 4 + Tailwind CSS (migrated from vanilla HTML)

> A purpose-driven foundation dedicated to simplifying societal complexity so that every citizen and leader can make conscious, informed, and impactful decisions.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://happybein.com/): Overview of HappyBein and YeahVibe.
- [The HappyBein Manifesto](https://happybein.com/manifesto): Why we exist, how we operate, and what we believe.
- [YeahVibe Roadmap](https://happybein.com/roadmap): Three-phase product roadmap.
- [Our Initiatives](https://happybein.com/initiatives): The five active initiatives in the Yeah ecosystem.
- [Connect & Collaborate](https://happybein.com/contact): Email: happybein1@gmail.com

## Initiatives

- [HappyBein Foundation](https://happybein.com/initiatives#happybein): The architect. Non-profit research studio. Eindhoven, NL. Founded 2021.
- [YeahVibe](https://yeahvibe.com): Core platform. Practical framework built around 5 levers of change (direction & priorities, mindset, surroundings & processes, collaboration & leadership, YeahSight).
- [YeahSight](https://yeahsight.com): World context tool. Decodes global trends — energy, economy, technology, society — into plain language.
- [YeahDev](https://yeahdev.com): Article repository. No-fluff guides on AI, marketing, SEO, and getting your first customers, for founders and makers.
- [DailyApp](https://dailyapp.happybein.com): A collection of lightweight, focused daily tools, each doing one thing well with no accounts or subscriptions — DailyTracker (habit streaks), SpeakNote (local voice-to-text), QuickTimer (preset/custom timers), YeahVibe Workout (micro-exercise prompts), and YeahVibe GameTrack (score tracking).
